options.label: Benzene (6 π e⁻, planar, cyclic — 4n+2 with n=1)
1,3-cyclohexadiene (not fully conjugated, sp3 CH2 breaks it)

explanation: Aromatic needs: (1) cyclic, (2) planar, (3) fully conjugated (every ring atom p-orbital), (4) 4n+2 π electrons. Benzene: 6 π e⁻ (n=1). Cyclobutadiene: 4 π e⁻ (antiaromatic). Cyclohexadiene: has sp3 carbons breaking conjugation.
